release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.9 corrects the Owner Console layout and visual system from real Stable screenshots. In Top/Classic appearance, the Owner Console launcher is now a compact black-and-white control anchored to the true center of the top header instead of drifting with the right-side utility cluster. In Sidebar appearance, Owner Console is moved into the left navigation and placed below all normal workspace tabs, with collapsed-sidebar behavior preserved. The launcher removes the oversized blue/purple mini-card treatment, Network Controls subtitle and LIVE pill. The Owner Console itself now has a final black/graphite/white presentation authority applied after Premium Shell, removing the legacy blue/cyan shell, navigation, cards, progress bars, badges, inputs and productivity surfaces while preserving restrained semantic success, warning and destructive states. Authorization, owner APIs, tasks, updater behavior and runtime boundaries are unchanged. The exact final main build passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight, Windows Consumer E2E, CodeQL, Private Core CI, real Chromium E2E and the 120-task browser soak.
